member1.bio: Civil Engineer, entrepreneur, and writer, he is the founder and President-Partner of the company. He has a solid track record in management, total quality, and industrial projects, accumulating over 30 years of experience. His leadership is marked by strategic vision, consistent technical base, and strong results orientation. Throughout his career, he has developed high-performance teams, consolidating an organizational culture based on technical competence, ethics, and valuing people.

member2.role: President-Partner | Marketing and International Business Specialist
member2.bio: Entrepreneur, graduated in Marketing and specialist in International Business. He acts nationally and internationally in developing strategies that strengthen brands, expand institutional presence, and generate high-value business opportunities. His work integrates strategic positioning, branding, institutional relationships, and market development, contributing to the company standing out consistently and competitively in the environments in which it operates.

member3.role: Partner | Director | Civil and Work Safety Engineer | MBA Project Management
member3.bio: Civil and Work Safety Engineer, with an MBA in Project Management. He has extensive experience in management, conception, and development of industrial projects. His trajectory is marked by technical rigor, structured planning, and strong commitment to safety, quality, and regulatory compliance. He acts strategically to ensure reliability, operational excellence, and quality of the solutions delivered by the company.

member4.role: Financial Manager | Administrator | MBA in Business Management
member4.bio: Professional with strategic performance in administrative and financial areas, responsible for the management, control, and efficiency of corporate activities. He has solid training and experience in Business Administration, with a systemic vision and ability to integrate processes to maximize organizational performance and sustainability.

securityPolicy.intro: Mako, through its SMS (Health, Safety and Environment) Policy, aims to ensure the commitment that its activities have a high level of protection for the health and safety of its employees, clients, suppliers and community, as well as for the Environment.
securityPolicy.programDesc: Through the Mako SMS Program, with its 5 premises and 22 principles, in addition to their respective tools, Mako will promote healthy work conditions, clarify and train its employees in safe work practices, in addition to promoting information for risk control in the workplace and Environmental protection.
securityPolicy.responsibilitiesDesc: All employees, from senior management to operations, are responsible for the safety of their colleagues and subordinates, and for environmental protection in activities under their control.
securityPolicy.commitment1: Operate with all documentation and records required by current legislation
securityPolicy.commitment2: Carry out the necessary reviews and disseminate the information contained in the documents
securityPolicy.commitment3: Always seek high SMS excellence standards through continuous improvement
securityPolicy.commitment4: Promote people development, application of best practices at all levels
securityPolicy.contactDesc: For additional information about our security policy, contact us:

qualityPolicy.intro: Mako aims to value the quality of its services with regard to the total satisfaction of its clients, employees, partners, suppliers, environment and shareholder partners.
qualityPolicy.commitmentDesc: Mako is committed to supporting this quality policy through training actions for employees and partners, and through continuous improvement of its standards.
qualityPolicy.systemDesc: The principles and procedures of the Mako Quality System will be the basis for the necessary controls to achieve a world-class quality standard in products and services.
qualityPolicy.responsibilityText:
All MAKO employees are responsible for complying with applicable requirements, premises, procedures and best practices written and unwritten in this policy.
